trial_court: Court of Civil Judge-02, Shahdara, District, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi, Civil Suit No: 97/21
case_name: Chander Pal Singh vs Pooja Devi
facts_of_case: The plaintiff sought recovery of Rs.3,00,000/- along with interest @ 18% per annum since 12.12.2017 till realization and cost of the suit.

legal_principles.principle: A party who files a suit must prove its case by leading evidence and not rely on mere allegations.
legal_principles.held: No replication has been filed by the plaintiff to the written statement filed on behalf of the defendant.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot rely on false and fabricated facts with malafide intentions to file a suit.
legal_principles.held: The plaintiff has filed the present suit on the basis of false and fabricated facts with malafide intentions and ulterior motive.

outcome.final_order: Decree in favour of the plaintiff for recovery of Rs.3,00,000/- along with interest @ 18% per annum since 12.12.2017 till realization and cost of the suit.

use_for_drafting: drafting a suit for recovery of amount with interest
